item.title: HTB: Nanocorp - Active Directory Hard Walkthrough
item.description: NanoCorp is a Hard Windows Active Directory machine featuring a realistic exploit chain that combines recent Windows vulnerabilities with Active Directory misconfigurations. The attack begins by exploiting CVE-2025-24071 to trigger an NTLM hash leakage using a malicious ZIP archive. After successfully cracking the hash, Active Directory enumeration reveals several misconfigured ACL permissions, enabling privilege escalation to the monitoring_svc account. This account, being a member of the Protected Users group, requires Kerberos authentication to establish WinRM access. Finally, exploiting CVE-2024-0670 within the Checkmk agent grants full NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM privileges on the Domain Controller.
